title: Lucia — Fine Art Print (2025)
caption: Museum-grade fine art print · 30 × 40 cm · 2025
description_html:
Lucia is a museum-grade fine art print from The Existentialist series. It portrays the fragile balance between light and decay — a meditation on endurance, identity, and the slow persistence of empathy beneath silence.

Composed in 2025 at a scale of 30 × 40 cm, the image remains still yet charged — an observation of how presence continues through loss.

title: Mirror — Digital Self-Portrait (2025)
caption: Museum-grade fine art print · 40 × 40 cm · 2025
description_html:
Mirror is a museum-grade fine art print of a digital self-portrait confronting erosion from within. The violet haze rising from the hollow eye embodies illness — quiet, invasive, unrelenting. Threaded through it, fine golden strands mark the brief resistance of creative thought, flickering against decay.

Created in 2025 as part of The Existentialist series, it observes endurance without sentiment — the mind shaping form even as it fades.
dedication_html: For those who create light from the residue of pain.
